newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere issues GDRs worth $77 mln - ING Bank.
newsitem.headline: Solidere issues GDRs worth $77 mln - ING Bank.

text.p: Lebanon's biggest company Solidere on Wednesday issued 6.17 million GDRs worth $77 million, an executive of syndicate member ING Bank in Beirut said.
The Global Depositary Receipts were issued at $11.5 each and were currently trading at $11.50-$12.00, Jean-Yves Mallat, Head of ING's Private Banking Group in Beirut told Reuters.
The issue was lead managed by Merrill Lynch International and co-lead managed by ING Barings, Robert Fleming, UBS and Paribas Capital Markets, he said.
The first trade was made at $11.75, Mallat added.
